_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. This is the shape of the body POSTed to the IcePanel Flows API (POST /v1/landscapes/{landscapeId}/versions/{versionId}/flows). The originId/targetId/parentId/diagramId values below are placeholder slugs — IcePanel assigns real random IDs at import, so create_icepanel_flow.py resolves them live instead of using this file. Kept here so you can see the structure.
name: AI-driven energy calculation

step-1.description: A researcher asks ChopChopMol to compute the energy of the loaded molecule.

step-2.description: Types a natural-language command in the chat panel.

step-3.description: The frontend streams the message + molecule state to the Flask backend over SSE.

step-4.description: The backend calls Claude with the tool definitions; Claude returns a calculate_energy tool call.

step-5.description: The frontend executes the tool, requesting a MACE energy + forces calculation.

step-6.description: Runs the MACE ML potential (PyTorch/ASE) and returns energy plus per-atom forces.

step-7.description: The frontend caches the result and renders an energy chart with force arrows for the user.
